home.subtitle: The companion that helps you understand your body and live healthy every day.

home.intro.description: HealthSphere provides all the tools you need to build and maintain a healthy lifestyle — simple, intuitive, and effective.
home.features.track.title: Track Your Progress
home.features.track.description: Log your meals, activities, and weight. Clear charts help you visualize your progress and stay motived on your health journey.
home.features.nutrition.title: AI Nutrition Coach
home.features.nutrition.description: Get instant calorie and nutrition analysis just by taking a photo of your meal. Healthy eating has never been simpler.
home.features.workout.title: Personalized AI Workouts
home.features.workout.description: Receive workout routines tailored to your goals and fitness level, helping you get stronger and healthier every day.
home.features.sleep.title: Analyze Your Sleep
home.features.sleep.description: Record your sleep patterns to understand your rest cycles. Get personalized insights to improve sleep quality for better recovery and daily energy.
